title.en: An Act Constituting the Third Congressional District of the Province of Albay into a Separate Highway Engineering District
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Third Congressional District of the Province of Albay into a Separate Highway Engineering District

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1970/ra_6152_1970.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, upon the recommendation of the Commissioner of Public Highways and approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, the third congressional district of the Province of Albay is hereby constituted into a separate highway engineering district, under a highway district engineer with permanent station in the Municipality of Ligao.
The Commissioner of Public Highways, with the approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, shall organize the Highway Engineering District hereby created.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 9, 1970.
